run_GAN_training: run the GAN training loop for body to hand pose estimation with generator and discriminator models
train_generator: train the generator network using L1 regression loss and adversarial GAN loss on training data
train_discriminator: train the discriminator network to distinguish real hand motion from generated fake motion
validate_generator: validate the generator on test data and save checkpoint if current best loss improves
load_data: load and preprocess training data from video windows, standardize features, and split into train test sets
